tal-a11-p01 · verses 11.1-11.10 · WITHHELD

kalādhvā vakṣyate śrīmacchāṃbhavājñānusārataḥ // 1b yathā pūrvoktabhuvanamadhye nijanijaṃ gaṇam / anuyatparato bhinnaṃ tattvaṃ nāmeti bhaṇyate tathā teṣvapi tattveṣu svavarge@nugamātmakam / vyāvṛttaṃ paravargācca kaleti śivaśāsane kecidāhuḥ punaryāsau śaktirantaḥ susūkṣmikā / tattvānāṃ sā kaletyuktā dharaṇyāṃ dhārikā yathā atra pakṣadvaye vastu na bhinnaṃ bhāsate yataḥ / anugāmi na sāmānyamiṣṭaṃ naiyāyikādivat anye vadanti dīkṣādau sukhasaṃgrahaṇārthataḥ / śivena kalpito vargaḥ kaleti samayāśrayaḥ kṛtaśca devadevena samayo@paramārthatām / na gacchatīti nāsatyo na cānyasamayodayaḥ nivṛttiḥ pṛthivītattve pratiṣṭhāvyaktagocare / vidyā niśānte śāntā ca śaktyante@ṇḍamidaṃ catuḥ śāntātītā śive tattve kalātītaḥ paraḥ śivaḥ / nahyatra vargīkaraṇaṃ samayaḥ kalanāpi vā yujyate sarvatodikkaṃ svātantryollāsadhāmani / svātantryāttu nijaṃ rūpaṃ boddhṛdharmādavicyutam

tal-a11-p02 · verses 11.11-11.20 · WITHHELD

upadeśatadāveśaparamārthatvasiddhaye / bodhyatāmānayandevaḥ sphuṭameva vibhāvyate yato@taḥ śivatattve@pi kalāsaṃgatirucyate / aṇḍaṃ ca nāma bhuvanavibhāgasthitikāraṇam prāhurāvaraṇaṃ tacca śaktyantaṃ yāvadasti hi / yadyapi prāk śivākhye@pi tattve bhuvanapaddhatiḥ uktā tathāpyapratighe nāsminnāvṛtisaṃbhavaḥ / nanvevaṃ dharaṇīṃ muktvā śaktau prakṛtimāyayoḥ api cāpratighatve@pi kathamaṇḍasya saṃbhavaḥ / atrāsmadguravaḥ prāhuryatpṛthivyādipañcakam pratyakṣamidamābhāti tato@nyannāsti kiṃcana / meyatve sthūlasūkṣmatvānmānatve karaṇatvataḥ kartṛtollāsataḥ kartṛbhāve sphuṭatayoditam / triṃśattattvaṃ vibhedātma tadabhedo niśā matā kāryatvakaraṇatvādivibhāgagalane sati / vikāsotkasvatantratve śivāntaṃ pañcakaṃ jaguḥ śrīmatkālottarādau ca kathitaṃ bhūyasā tathā / pañcaitāni tu tattvāni yairvyāptamakhilaṃ jagat pañcamantratanau tena sadyojātādi bhaṇyate / īśānāntaṃ tatra tatra dharādigaganāntakam

tal-a11-p03 · verses 11.21-11.30 · WITHHELD

śivatattvamataḥ śūnyātiśūnyaṃ syādanāśri[vṛ]tam / yattu sarvāvibhāgātma svatantraṃ bodhasundaram saptatriṃśaṃ tu tatprāhustattvaṃ paraśivābhidham / tasyāpyuktanayādvedyabhāve@tra parikalpite yadāste hyanavacchinnaṃ tadaṣṭātriṃśamucyate / na cānavasthā hyevaṃ syāddṛśyatāṃ hi mahātmabhiḥ yadvedyaṃ kiṃcidābhāti tatkṣaye yatprakāśate / tattattvamiti nirṇītaṃ ṣaṭtriṃśaṃ hṛdi bhāsate tatkiṃ na kiṃcidvā kiṃcidityākāṅkṣāvaśe vapuḥ / cidānandasvatantraikarūpaṃ taditi deśane saptatriṃśaṃ samābhāti tatrākāṅkṣā ca nāparā / taccāpi klṛptavedyatvaṃ yatra bhāti sa cinmayaḥ aṣṭātriṃśattamaḥ so@pi bhāvanāyopadiśyate / yadi nāma tataḥ saptatriṃśa eva punarbhavet avibhāgasvatantratvacinmayatvādidharmatā / samaiva vedyīkaraṇaṃ kevalaṃ tvadhikaṃ yataḥ dharāyāṃ guṇatattvānte māyānte kramaśaḥ sthitāḥ / gandho raso rūpamantaḥ sūkṣmabhāvakrameṇa tu iti sthite naye śaktitattvānte@pyasti saukṣmyabhāk / sparśaḥ ko@pi sadā yasmai yoginaḥ spṛhayālavaḥ

tal-a11-p04 · verses 11.31-11.40 · WITHHELD

tatsparśānte tu saṃvittiḥ śuddhacidvyomarūpiṇī / yasyāṃ rūḍhaḥ samabhyeti svaprakāśātmikāṃ parām ato vindurato nādo rūpamasmādato rasaḥ / ityuktaṃ kṣobhakatvena spande sparśastu no tathā mataṃ caitanmaheśasya śrīpūrve yadabhāṣata / dhārikāpyāyinī boddhrī pavitrī cāvakāśadā ebhiḥ śabdairvyavaharan nivṛttyādernijaṃ vapuḥ / pañcatattvavidhiḥ proktastritattvamadhunocyate vijñānākalaparyantamātmā vidyeśvarāntakam / śeṣe śivastritattve syādekatattve śivaḥ param imau bhedāvubhau tattvabhedamātrakṛtāviti / tattvādhvaivāyamitthaṃ ca na ṣaḍadhvasthiteḥ kṣatiḥ prakṛt pumānyatiḥ kālo māyā vidyeśasauśivau / śivaśca navatattve@pi vidhau tattvādhvarūpatā evamaṣṭādaśākhye@pi vidhau nyāyaṃ vadetsudhīḥ / yatra yatra hi bhogecchā tatprādhānyopayogataḥ anyāntarbhāvanātaśca dīkṣānantavibhedabhāk / tena ṣaṭtriṃśato yāvadekatattvavidhirbhavet tattvādhvaiva sa devena prokto vyāsasamāsataḥ / ekatattvavidhiścaiṣa suprabuddhaṃ guruṃ prati

tal-a11-p05 · verses 11.41-11.50 · WITHHELD

śiṣyaṃ ca gatabhogāśamuditaḥ śaṃbhunā yataḥ / bhedaṃ visphārya visphārya śaktyā svacchandarūpayā svātmanyabhinne bhagavānnityaṃ viśramayan sthitaḥ / itthaṃ tryātmādhvano bhedaḥ sthūlasūkṣmaparatvataḥ meyabhāgagataḥ proktaḥ puratattvakalātmakaḥ / adhunā mātṛbhāgasthaṃ rūpaṃ tredhā nirūpyate yatpramāṇātmakaṃ rūpamadhvano mātṛbhāgagam / padaṃ hyavagamātmatvasamāveśāttaducyate tadeva ca padaṃ mantraḥ prakṣobhātpracyutaṃ yadā / guptabhāṣī yato mātā tūṣṇīṃbhūto vyavasthitaḥ tathāpi na vimarśātma rūpaṃ tyajati tena saḥ / pramāṇātmavimarśātmā mānavatkṣobhabhāṅnatu mantrāṇāṃ ca padānāṃ ca tenoktaṃ trikaśāsane / abhinnameva svaṃ rūpaṃ niḥspandakṣobhite param audāsīnyaparityāge prakṣobhānavarohaṇe / varṇādhvā mātṛbhāge syāt pūrvaṃ yā kathitā pramā sā tu pūrṇasvarūpatvādavibhāgamayī yataḥ / tata ekaikavarṇatvaṃ tattve tattve kṣamāditaḥ kṛtvā śaive pare proktāḥ ṣoḍaśārṇā visargataḥ / tatra śaktiparispandastāvān prāk ca nirūpitaḥ

tal-a11-p06 · verses 11.51-11.60 · WITHHELD

saṃkalayyocyate sarvamadhunā sukhasaṃvide / padamantravarṇamekaṃ puraṣoḍaśakaṃ dhareti ca nivṛttiḥ / tattvārṇamagninayanaṃ rasaśarapuramastramantrapadamanyā munitattvārṇaṃ dvikapadamantraṃ vasvakṣibhuvanamaparakalā / agnyarṇatattvamekakapadamantraṃ sainyabhuvanamiti turyā ṣoḍaśa varṇāḥ padamantratattvamekaṃ ca śāntyatīteyam / abhinavaguptenāryātrayamuktaṃ saṃgrahāya śiṣyebhyaḥ so@yaṃ samasta evādhvā bhairavābhedavṛttimān / tatsvātantryātsvatantratvamaśnuvāno@vabhāsate tathāhi mātṛrūpastho mantrādhveti nirūpitaḥ / tathāhi cidvimarśena grastā vācyadaśā yadā śivajñānakriyāyattamananatrāṇatatparā / aśeṣaśaktipaṭalīlīlālāmpaṭyapāṭavāt cyutā mānamayādrūpāt saṃvinmantrādhvatāṃ gatā / pramāṇarūpatāmetya prayātyadhvā padātmatām tathā hi māturviśrāntirvarṇānsaṃghaṭya tānbahūn / saṃghaṭṭanaṃ ca kramikaṃ saṃjalpātmakameva tat vikalpasya svakaṃ rūpaṃ bhogāveśamayaṃ sphuṭam / ataḥ pramāṇatārūpaṃ padamasmadgururjagau pramāṇarūpatāveśamaparityajya meyatām

gacchankalanayā yogādadhvā proktaḥ kalātmakaḥ / śuddhe prameyatāyoge sūkṣmasthūlatvabhāgini tattvādhvabhuvanādhvatve krameṇānusaredguruḥ / prameyamānamātṝṇāṃ yadrūpamupari sthitam pramātmātra sthito@dhvāyaṃ varṇātmā dṛśyatāṃ kila / ucchalatsaṃvidāmātraviśrāntyāsvādayoginaḥ sarvābhidhānasāmarthyādaniyantritaśaktayaḥ / sṛṣṭāḥ svātmasahotthe@rthe dharāparyantabhāgini āmṛśantaḥ svacidbhūmau tāvato@rthānabhedataḥ / varṇaughāste pramārūpāṃ satyāṃ bibhrati saṃvidam bālāstiryakpramātāro ye@pyasaṃketabhāginaḥ / te@pyakṛtrimasaṃskārasārāmenāṃ svasaṃvidam bhinnabhinnāmupāśritya yānti citrāṃ pramātṛtām / asyā cākṛtrimānantavarṇasaṃvidi rūḍhatām saṃketā yānti cette@pi yāntyasaṃketavṛttitām / anayā tu vinā sarve saṃketā bahuśaḥ kṛtāḥ aviśrāntatayā kuryuranavasthāṃ duruttarām / bālo vyutpādyate yena tatra saṃketamārgaṇāt aṅgulyādeśane@pyasya nāvikalpā tathā matiḥ / vikalpaḥ śabdamūlaśca śabdaḥ saṃketajīvitaḥ

tal-a11-p08 · verses 11.71-11.80 · WITHHELD

tenānanto hyamāyīyo yo varṇagrāma īdṛśaḥ / saṃvidvimarśasacivaḥ sadaiva sa hi jṛmbhate yata eva ca māyīyā varṇāḥ sūtiṃ vitenire / ye ca māyīyavarṇeṣu vīryatvena nirūpitāḥ saṃketanirapekṣāste prameti parigṛhyatām / tathā hi paravākyeṣu śruteṣvāvriyate nijā pramā yasya jaḍo@sau no tatrārthe@bhyeti mātṛtām / śukavatsa paṭhatyeva paraṃ tatkramitaikabhāk svātantryalābhataḥ svākyapramālābhe tu boddhṛtā / yasya hi svapramābodho vipakṣodbhedanigrahāt vākyādivarṇapuñje sve sa pramātā vaśībhavet / yathā yathā cākṛtakaṃ tadrūpamatiricyate tathā tathā camatkāratāratamyaṃ vibhāvyate / ādyāmāyīyavarṇāntarnimagne cottarottare sakete pūrvapūrvāṃśamajjane pratibhābhidaḥ / ādyodrekamahattve@pi pratibhātmani niṣṭhitāḥ dhruvaṃ kavitvavaktṛtvaśālitāṃ yānti sarvataḥ / yāvaddhāmani saṃketanikārakalanojjhite viśrāntaścinmaye kiṃ kiṃ na vetti kurute na vā / ata eva hi vāksiddhau varṇānāṃ samupāsyatā

tal-a11-p09 · verses 11.81-11.90 · WITHHELD

sarvajñatvādisiddhau vā kā siddhiryā na tanmayī / taduktaṃ varadena śrīsiddhayogīśvarīmate tena guptena guptāste śeṣā varṇāstviti sphuṭam / evaṃ māmātṛmānatvameyatvairyo@vabhāsate ṣaḍvidhaḥ svavapuḥśuddhau śuddhiṃ so@dhvādhigacchati / ekena vapuṣā śuddhau tatraivānyaprakāratām antarbhāvyācarecchuddhimanusaṃdhānavān guruḥ / anantarbhāvaśaktau tu sūkṣmaṃ sūkṣmaṃ tu śodhayet tadviśuddhaṃ bījabhāvāt sūte nottarasaṃtatim / śodhanaṃ bahudhā tattadbhogaprāptyekatānatā tadādhipatyaṃ tattyāgastacchivātmatvavedanam / tallīnatā tannirāsaḥ sarvaṃ caitatkramākramāt ata eva ca te mantrāḥ śodhakāścitrarūpiṇaḥ / siddhāntavāmadakṣādau citrāṃ śuddhiṃ vitanvate anuttaratrikānāmakramamantrāstu ye kila / te sarve sarvadāḥ kintu kasyācit kvāpi mukhyatā ataḥ śodhakabhāvena śāstre śrīpūrvasaṃjñite / parāparādimantrāṇāmadhvanyuktā vyavasthitiḥ śodhakatvaṃ ca mālinyā devīnāṃ tritayasya ca / devatrayasya vaktrāṇāmaṅgānāmaṣṭakasya ca

kiṃ vātibahunā dvāravāstvādhāragurukrame / lokapāstravidhau mantrān muktvā sarvaṃ viśodhakam yaccaitadadhvanaḥ proktaṃ śodhyatvaṃ śoddhṛtā ca yā / sā svātantryācchivābhede yuktetyuktaṃ ca śāsane sarvametadvibhātyeva parameśitari dhruve / pratibimbasvarūpeṇa na tu bāhyatayā yataḥ cidvyomnyeva śive tattaddehādimatirīdṛśī / bhinnā saṃsāriṇāṃ rajjau sarpasragvīcibuddhivat yataḥ prāgdehamaraṇasiddhāntaḥ svapnagocaraḥ / dehāntarādirmaraṇe kīdṛgvā dehasaṃbhavaḥ svapne@pi pratibhāmātrasāmānyaprathanābalāt / viśeṣāḥ pratibhāsante na bhāvyante@pi te yathā śālagrāmopalāḥ keciccitrākṛtibhṛto yathā / tathā māyādibhūmyantalekhācitrahṛdaścitaḥ nagarārṇavaśailādyāstadicchānuvidhāyinaḥ / na svayaṃ sadasanto no kāraṇākāraṇātmakāḥ niyateścirarūḍhāyāḥ samucchedātpravartanāt / arūḍhāyāḥ svatantro@yaṃ sthitaścidvyomabhairavaḥ ekacinmātrasaṃpūrṇabhairavābhedabhāgini / evamasmītyanāmarśo bhedako bhāvamaṇḍale
